title: Gulf Dead Zone Rebounded To 6,705 Square Miles
hook: The Gulf dead zone grew again instead of shrinking.
closing: Protecting Gulf sea life starts by reducing the fertilizer feeding this oxygen loss.
question: Who should pay to reduce runoff?

segments.say: The Gulf dead zone reached 6,705 square miles, more than double its previous reading.
The Gulf dead zone's current average is 3,745 square miles, leaving cleanup far behind the goal.
Gulf nitrogen load reached 300 percent of its earlier level, feeding oxygen-stealing algae.
